behavior: The journal owns the campaign record's transaction. An accepted whole-envelope PUT on a journal-native campaign appends a CampaignSnapshotPublished checkpoint of the stored record, and a create appends the genesis, in ONE immediate transaction the journal writer owns (appendPreparedWithExtension), with the campaigns row write as its extension; the journal head is never behind the record, and a genesis refusal never leaves a committed row behind a 500. The service's row write becomes a function the writer's transaction calls. Non-journal campaigns (while the flag is off) keep today's save path exactly. The adopt route's stale header is corrected. The flag is unchanged.

the contract line "Nested `saveCampaign` is forbidden": the extension may not call saveCampaign (it opens its own handle and transaction), so the row write must be a borrowed-handle function

transactionDesign.summary: Option (i) of U35's admission (u35-admission-20260922.json proposedSplit, U35b designQuestionFirst), as the ledger decided: the journal writer owns the one immediate transaction and the campaigns row write is its extension.
transactionDesign.service: CampaignPersistenceService.ts: saveCampaign's transaction body is split into planCampaignSave(db, envelope, baseVersion, hostInstanceId) (read-only: row read, prepareCampaignWrite D2 gate, sourceReplayFence guard, baseVersion CAS; returns conflict | refused | failed | ok with the record to store) and writeCampaignRow(db, record) (the INSERT OR REPLACE). saveCampaign composes the two in its own transaction exactly as today: the non-journal path.
transactionDesign.markerStore: CampaignMigrationMarkerStore.ts: writeCampaignMigrationMarker takes an optional borrowed handle (default: the service handle, so every existing caller is unchanged).
transactionDesign.genesisModule: campaignSourceGenesis.ts: the snapshot command (projection, CampaignSnapshotPublished event, state digest, system principal, command id) is extracted into one builder used by appendCampaignGenesis (byte-identical genesis: sequence 0, revision 0, commandId campaign-genesis:<id>, actor campaign-source-genesis) and by the checkpoint (sequence = the root head revision, payload revision = that sequence, commandId campaign-checkpoint:<id>:<sequence>, actor campaign-record-checkpoint, scope campaign). maybeAppendCampaignGenesisOnCreate, whose one caller is the route, is removed with its test block.
transactionDesign.transactionModule: new src/lib/campaign/authority/campaignRecordJournalSave.ts: saveCampaignRecordThroughJournal(journal, {purpose: genesis | checkpoint, envelope, baseVersion, hostInstanceId, occurredAt}) calls journal.appendPreparedWithExtension. prepare (read-only, on the writer's handle): planCampaignSave; a conflict/refused/failed plan returns before any write; read the campaign stream's root head revision; build the snapshot command of the PLANNED stored record; a projection refusal returns invalid-campaign-projection before any write. extend: writeCampaignRow on the borrowed handle, then append(); a checkpoint append that does not commit throws (the row rolls back with it); a genesis append refused by the revision or command-identity guard keeps today's already-journaled outcome (row kept, no marker); a committed genesis writes the journal-native marker on the same handle.
transactionDesign.route: src/pages/api/campaigns/[id].ts PUT, after the blocked check: authority journal -> checkpoint transaction (any baseVersion; the CAS still answers 409 for a stale one); else baseVersion 0 and isCampaignJournalAuthorityEnabled() -> genesis transaction; else saveCampaign unchanged. invalid-campaign-projection answers 500 with nothing written (genesis keeps its message "campaign genesis failed: ..."; checkpoint says "campaign checkpoint failed: ..."). A thrown failure inside the transaction answers 500 through the existing catch.

risksForTheParent: Review classes authority + migration + idempotency: the owner's head-bound Lane B ruling is required on the head that merges; U35d (the flip) depends on this unit landing first.

Authority: a checkpoint REPLACES the journal's projected state (CampaignSnapshotPublished replaces state wholesale, applyCampaignEvent.ts:75) with the record's projection. Journal-only command effects since the last row materialization (only AcceptContract rewrites the row; SpendFunds, AdvanceDay, HirePilot and the rest append only) are overwritten by a PUT at the current row version whose envelope does not carry them, and the projection leaves pilots and contracts empty as the genesis does. This is option (i) as the ledger decided; the ruling should name it.

The authority decision (journal vs snapshot) is read before the transaction, as the blocked check is today; a marker that turns journal between that read and the save lets that one save take the snapshot path.

Migration: no schema change and the flag is unchanged, but the checkpoint path is live now for every campaign that already carries a journal marker (fixture-armed e2e runs, operator cutovers, co-op campaigns created under the arm), independent of U35d.

Idempotency: the checkpoint command id is campaign-checkpoint:<id>:<sequence>; a retried PUT is a fresh CAS attempt (its baseVersion is stale after a commit, so it answers 409 and appends nothing). The genesis keeps appendCampaignGenesis's identity (campaign-genesis:<id>).
Not in the sentence and not built: the checkpoint is not fanned out to live co-op guests, and the PUT does not consult the projection-rebuild lease that blocks commands.

Playwright is not run in this lane: fixture-armed e2e groups (authority-recovery, the two-process privacy and convergence specs) now see a checkpoint event after a whole-envelope save of a journal-native campaign.
decision: go: --next printed U35b on the baseline, the validator passed, and the design needs no edit outside the ownership paths
